$comment: 语法大厅 G27（V0.9 P3 进阶层）。比喻锚点：延音线vs断音：音还在响vs音已断。承接骨架层 G26（KET 限定七搭配），本课展开 been vs gone、since/for 深辨、与一般过去时系统对比，开头一句回指「G26 学过的延音线，这里加长」。暗线：have 语法化——一人报时其余冻结的规律再现。全部内容原创。
title: 现在完成时进阶：been/gone 与 since/for
metaphor: 延音线vs断音：音还在响vs音已断
ketNote: KET 只考 G26 那七个搭配的基本用法；been vs gone、since/for 深辨和与过去时的系统对比是初中重头戏，KET 不直接考。这课为初中/PET 打底——学到就是赚到，不用焦虑。

sections.essence: 延音线还在响用现在完成时；音已断、有日期，就交给一般过去时。
sections.why: G26 学过的延音线，这里把它加长。中文只有一个「了」：「我吃了」到底是刚吃完现在饱着，还是昨天中午吃的，全靠听的人猜。英语把这两件事分成两种调：音还在响——事情的影响延续到现在（I have lost my key，现在还进不了门），用现在完成时这条延音线；音已断——事情钉死在过去某个时刻（I lost my key yesterday），用一般过去时这个断音。切换的开关是时间词：yesterday、last year、in 2020 这类「有日期」的词一出现，延音线立刻剪断，只能用过去时。been 和 gone、since 和 for，都是这条延音线上的进阶记号——初中要一路用到头。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐团的排练厅里有两种音。踩着延音踏板的音，弹完了还嗡嗡响到现在——这是现在完成时；干脆利落的断音，响过就停，钉死在乐谱的某一小节里——这是一般过去时。团长举了两个例子：I have been to the new concert hall.（我去过新音乐厅——人回来了，见识还挂在身上响）；My brother has gone to the concert hall.（他去了——人还没回，正在那儿）。been 是去过且回来了，gone 是去了还没回，一个字母的差别，人在不在场全靠它。延音线还得标长度：for 报一段——for three years，这个音拉了三年；since 报起点——since 2022，从那年起一直响到现在。最后团长敲了敲谱架：「谱上一旦写了 yesterday 这种日期，延音线必须当场剪断，换断音。」

cards.rule: 延音线 vs 断音：先问影响还在不在
cards.detail: 事情的结果延续到现在（延续/经历）→ 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词；事情钉死在过去某刻 → 一般过去时。
cards.example: I have lost my key.（现在还进不了门）/ I lost my key yesterday.

cards.rule: 有日期的词 = 剪断延音线
cards.detail: yesterday / last week / in 2020 / two days ago / just now 一出现，只能用一般过去时——完成时从不和具体日期同框。
cards.example: I saw the film last Sunday.（✗ have seen ... last Sunday）

cards.detail: have been to 去过（人已回来，说的是经历）；have gone to 去了（人没回，在路上或在那儿）。
cards.example: She has been to Beijing twice. / She has gone to Beijing.（她现在不在这儿）

cards.rule: for + 一段长度，since + 一个起点
cards.detail: for three years / for a long time 报长度；since 2022 / since last month 报起点，since 还能接过去时小句（since we met）。
cards.example: I have lived here for ten years. / I have lived here since 2016.

cards.rule: How long 挂在延音线上
cards.detail: 问「延续了多久」用 How long have you...?，回答交给 for 或 since。
cards.example: — How long have you known him? — Since we were seven.

cards.detail: die / buy / come / join / begin 一瞬间就完成，不能直接接 for/since——换成可延续的状态：be dead / have had / be in / be on。
cards.example: He has had this bike for two years.（✗ has bought ... for two years）

basic.en: I have finished my homework, so I can play now.
basic.cn: 作业写完了，现在可以玩了。（影响延续到现在）

basic.en: She has lost her ticket and she is crying.
basic.cn: 她把票弄丢了，正哭着呢。（现在还没找到）

basic.en: We have known each other since Grade One.
basic.cn: 我们从一年级就认识。（since + 起点）

basic.en: My uncle has worked in the hospital for ten years.
basic.cn: 我叔叔在医院工作十年了。（for + 长度）

basic.en: I have been to the Great Wall twice.
basic.cn: 我去过长城两次。（人回来了——been）

mid.en: My cousin has gone to Shanghai — he isn't here.
mid.cn: 表哥去上海了——人不在。（没回来——gone）

mid.en: I saw that film last month, so I don't want to see it again.
mid.cn: 那部电影我上个月看的，不想再看了。（有日期→断音）

mid.en: — How long have you had this guitar? — For five years.
mid.cn: ——这把琴你有多久了？——五年了。（buy 换成 have 才能量长度）

mid.en: The band has played together since 2020.
mid.cn: 乐队从 2020 年合作到现在。

mid.en: He has just come back from the library.
mid.cn: 他刚从图书馆回来。（just 挂延音线）

trap.en: I have seen this film. I saw it with Dad last Saturday.
trap.cn: 这部电影我看过。上周六和爸爸看的。
trap.note: 先说经历用延音线；一补上 last Saturday 的日期，第二句立刻换断音。

trap.en: — Where is Amy? — She has gone to the music room.
trap.note: 人不在场只能用 gone；用 been 就成了「去过又回来了」，和「人呢」对不上。

trap.en: My grandpa has been a teacher for thirty years.
trap.cn: 我爷爷当了三十年老师。
trap.note: 「当老师」是可延续的状态，能配 for；不能说 has become a teacher for thirty years。

trap.en: We have lived in this town since my sister was born.
trap.cn: 从我妹妹出生起，我们就住在这个镇上。
trap.note: since 后面可以跟过去时小句——起点是「妹妹出生」那一刻。

trap.en: His dog has been dead for two years.
trap.note: die 是瞬间音，不能 has died for two years——换状态 be dead 才能拉长。

trap.en: I got up at six and I have been busy since then.
trap.cn: 我六点起的床，从那以后一直忙到现在。
trap.note: 一句话两种调：起床钉在六点用过去时；「从那以后一直忙」延续到现在用完成时。

redBlack.bad: — Where is Tom? — He has been to the library.（人不在场）
redBlack.good: He has gone to the library.
redBlack.why: been 是「去过且回来了」——人明明不在，答 been 就前后矛盾，听的人还是找不到 Tom。

redBlack.bad: I have lost my key, but I found it later.（想说钥匙找回来了）
redBlack.good: I lost my key, but I found it later.
redBlack.why: 延音线表示「现在还丢着」，后半句又说找回来了——两截自相矛盾，钥匙到底在不在说不清。

redBlack.bad: I have seen the film last night.
redBlack.good: I saw the film last night.
redBlack.why: last night 有日期——延音线必须剪断，换一般过去时。
have/has 后面要过去分词——go→went→gone，went 是过去式。

redBlack.bad: We have knew each other for years.
redBlack.good: We have known each other for years.
redBlack.why: know 的过去分词是 known——两件套的第二件别穿错。

redBlack.bad: I have finished my homework just now.
redBlack.good: I finished my homework just now.
redBlack.why: just now（刚才）是过去时间词，配过去时；just（刚刚）才配完成时——一字之差两种调。

redBlack.bad: How long have you bought this bike?
redBlack.good: How long have you had this bike?
redBlack.why: buy 一瞬间就完成，量不了长度——问「拥有多久」用 have had。

redBlack.bad: They have lived here since three years.
redBlack.good: They have lived here for three years.
redBlack.why: since 接起点、for 接长度——「三年」是长度，归 for 管（或说 since three years ago）。

redBlack.bad: Has she finish her drawing yet?
redBlack.good: Has she finished her drawing yet?
redBlack.why: 完成时两件套 has + 过去分词——finish 忘了变形。

redBlack.bad: My parents have got married for twenty years.
redBlack.good: My parents have been married for twenty years.
redBlack.why: get married 是一瞬间的动作——量长度要换成状态 be married。

redBlack.bad: Did you eat yet?（美剧里常听到）
redBlack.good: Have you eaten yet? / Did you eat yet? 口语都通。
redBlack.why: 美式口语常用过去时 + yet，英式偏完成时——考试按完成时写，聊天听懂就行。

redBlack.bad: I have gotten a new phone.（有人说必须 got）
redBlack.why: get 的过去分词英美各一套——不挡意思，考试不设坑。

contrast.cn: 我吃了。（分不清刚吃完还是昨天吃的）
contrast.en: I have eaten. / I ate at noon.
contrast.diff: 中文一个「了」两头兼职；英语把「影响还在」和「钉在过去」分成两种调。

contrast.cn: 他去北京了。（人回没回不知道）
contrast.en: has gone（没回）/ has been（回来了）
contrast.diff: 英语用 been/gone 把「人在不在场」写进动词；中文要靠追问才知道。

contrast.cn: 我认识他三年了。（「了」+时长就行）
contrast.en: I have known him for three years.
contrast.diff: 中文加个「了」完事；英语要延音线 + for 报长度，两件都不能省。

contrast.cn: 从 2020 年起我就住这儿。
contrast.diff: 中文「从……起」配现在时；英语的 since 必须挂在完成时这条延音线上。

contrast.cn: 他的狗死了三年了。（中文说得通）
contrast.en: His dog has been dead for three years.
contrast.diff: 中文能给「死」量长度；英语 die 是瞬间音，要换成状态 be dead 才能拉长。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 有日期→断音；影响还在→延音；been 回来 gone 没回；for 长度 since 起点。
steps: 扫时间词：yesterday / last... / ...ago / in 2020 / just now → 一律一般过去时。
没有日期就问自己：这件事的结果现在还在吗？在 → have/has + 过去分词。
说「去过某地」先想人回没回：回来了 been，没回 gone。
量时间先分类：一段长度给 for，一个起点给 since（since 还能接过去时小句）。
瞬间动词（buy/die/come/join/begin）不能直接量长度——换状态：have had / be dead / be in / be on。
过去分词拿不准？回 G13 查那 40 位老团员。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，中文说『我吃了』，妈妈分不清你是刚吃完还是中午吃的。英语分成两种：音还在响——刚吃完所以现在饱着，说 I have eaten；音已经断了——昨天吃的，说 I ate yesterday。咱们玩『还响不响』：你说一件事，我问『它的影响现在还在吗』，还在就用 have，钉在过去某天就不用。再玩『人回没回』：我问 Where is 爸爸？你答 He has gone to work——人没回用 gone；周末聊去过哪儿，你说 I have been to...——人回来了用 been。我不懂英语没关系，我只听两件事：句子里出现『昨天』『去年』这种日子时，你还带没带 have 的音；说『去过』的时候，用的是 been 还是 gone。」
questions: 「我丢了钥匙」用英语怎么说，才能让人听出「现在还没找到」？
been 和 gone 差在哪？哪个说明人已经回来了？
for 和 since 各管什么？「三年」和「从 2020 年起」各归谁？

sections.echo: 现在完成时里，have/has 承担全部报时，过去分词一动不动——又是那条「一人报时、其余冻结」的分工规律（G29 的 be 是这样，这里的 have 也是，下一课 G28 的 had 还会是）。更有意思的是 have 自己的身世：它本来是实打实的「拥有」，可 I have eaten 里的 have 早就不表示拥有任何东西了——它被天天使用，磨损成了纯粹的语法工具，和 be、do 走的是同一条路。越常用的词，越早被磨成工具；框架越用越规整，零件越用越面目全非——这就是英语的秩序。

memoryCard.alt: G27 记忆卡：延音线（影响还在→have/has+过去分词）vs 断音（有日期→一般过去时）；been 去过人回来了 vs gone 去了没回；for+一段长度 vs since+起点；瞬间动词换状态才能量长度（have had/be dead/be in/be on）；警示 have seen...last night、since three years、How long have you bought。

stages.name: 认一认 · 延音还是断音

questions.q: yesterday 一出现，句子该用哪种调？
questions.explain: 有日期的词一出现，延音线必须剪断。

questions.q: 「事情的影响延续到现在」用哪种时态？
questions.explain: 音还在响——现在完成时这条延音线。

questions.q: 现在完成时的两件套是？
questions.explain: have/has 管报时，过去分词冻结不动。

questions.q: have been to 表示什么？
questions.explain: been 是经历——人已经回来了。

questions.q: have gone to 表示什么？
questions.explain: gone 是人还在路上或在那儿——不在场。

questions.q: for 后面接什么？
questions.explain: for 报长度——这个音拉了多久。

questions.q: since 后面接什么？
questions.explain: since 报起点——从哪一刻起一直响到现在。

questions.q: know 的过去分词（第三形态）是？
questions.explain: know→knew→known——have known。

questions.q: see 的过去分词（第三形态）是？
questions.explain: see→saw→seen——have seen。

questions.q: go 的过去分词（第三形态）是？
questions.explain: go→went→gone——been/gone 的 gone 就是它。

questions.q: just now（刚才）配哪种时态？
questions.explain: just now 是过去时间词；just（刚刚）才配完成时。

questions.q: How long have you...? 问的是？
options: 这件事延续了多长时间
questions.explain: How long 挂在延音线上，回答用 for/since。

questions.q: 句子里出现 in 2020，还能用现在完成时吗？
options: 不能——有日期就剪断延音线
questions.explain: 完成时从不和具体日期同框。

questions.q: die / buy / join 这类瞬间动词能直接接 for 吗？
options: 不能——要换成状态再量长度
questions.explain: 瞬间音拉不长——be dead / have had / be in。

questions.q: She has lost her pen. 钢笔现在找到了吗？
options: 还没有——延音线说明影响还在
questions.explain: 延音线还响着——笔到现在还丢着。

questions.q: I lost my pen this morning. 这句强调的是？
options: 丢笔发生在过去某个时刻
questions.explain: 断音只报告过去的事实，不管现在。

questions.q: I ___ my homework, so I can watch TV now.
questions.explain: 影响延续到现在（现在有空）——延音线。

questions.q: We ___ that museum last winter.
questions.explain: last winter 有日期——断音。

questions.q: She ___ her keys — she can't open the door now.
questions.explain: 现在开不了门，影响还在——has lost。

questions.q: My father ___ in this factory for twenty years.
questions.explain: for twenty years 挂延音线——has worked。

questions.q: — Where is Ben? — He ___ to the teachers' office.
questions.explain: 人不在场——gone。

questions.q: I ___ to Hainan twice with my parents.
questions.explain: 说经历、人回来了——have been to。

questions.q: We have known each other ___ we were five.
questions.explain: 起点是「五岁那年」——since + 过去时小句。

questions.q: The band has played together ___ ten years.
questions.explain: 「十年」是一段长度——for。

questions.q: My aunt ___ her hometown in 2015.
questions.explain: in 2015 有日期——断音 left。

questions.q: He ___ just ___ back from the sports meeting.
questions.explain: just 挂延音线——has come；come 的第三形态还是 come。

questions.q: — ___ you ever ___ a panda? — Yes, twice.
questions.explain: ever 问经历——Have you ever seen...?

questions.q: I ___ this bike for three years.
questions.explain: buy 量不了长度——「拥有三年」用 have had。

questions.q: She ___ her homework yet.
questions.explain: yet 挂延音线——hasn't finished。

questions.q: How long ___ your brother ___ in the army?
questions.explain: join 是瞬间动词——延续状态用 be in the army。

questions.q: The concert ___ ten minutes ago.
questions.explain: ...ago 有日期——断音 started。

questions.q: My grandparents ___ in this town since 1990.
questions.explain: since 1990 挂延音线——have lived。

stages.name: 改一改 · 剪错的延音线

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（这部电影我昨晚看的）
options: I saw this film last night.
I have seen this film last night.
I have saw this film last night.
questions.explain: last night 有日期——只能断音 saw。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（汤姆去图书馆了——人不在）
options: Tom has gone to the library.
Tom has been to the library.
Tom has going to the library.
questions.explain: 人不在场——gone；been 成了「去过又回来了」。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（我去过上海两次——人回来了）
options: I have been to Shanghai twice.
I have gone to Shanghai twice.
I have go to Shanghai twice.
questions.explain: 说经历用 been——gone 会变成「去了两次都没回来」。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（我认识他三年了）
options: I have known him for three years.
I have known him since three years.
I have knew him for three years.
questions.explain: 「三年」是长度归 for；分词是 known。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（我们从 2022 年起住在这儿）
questions.explain: 2022 是起点归 since，主句要挂延音线。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（作业刚才写完的）
options: I finished my homework just now.
I have finished my homework just now.
I finish my homework just now.
questions.explain: just now（刚才）配过去时——别和 just 弄混。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（他的狗死了两年了）
options: His dog has been dead for two years.
His dog has died for two years.
His dog died for two years.
questions.explain: die 是瞬间音——换状态 be dead 才能量长度。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（这辆车他买了五年了）
options: He has had this car for five years.
He has bought this car for five years.
He bought this car for five years.
questions.explain: 「买」量不了长度——「拥有五年」用 has had。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（她还没回来）
questions.explain: hasn't + 过去分词 come——came 是过去式。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（你曾经赢过奖吗）
options: Have you ever won a prize?
Did you ever won a prize?
Have you ever win a prize?
questions.explain: 问经历——Have you ever + 过去分词 won。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（电影已经开演十分钟了）
options: The film has been on for ten minutes.
The film has begun for ten minutes.
The film began for ten minutes.
questions.explain: begin 是瞬间音——延续状态用 be on。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（我刚丢了公交卡，现在进不了站）
options: I have lost my bus card, so I can't get in.
I have losed my bus card, so I can't get in.
I lose my bus card, so I can't get in.
questions.explain: 影响延续到现在——have lost（lose→lost）。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（爷爷当医生四十年了）
options: Grandpa has been a doctor for forty years.
Grandpa has become a doctor for forty years.
Grandpa became a doctor for forty years.
questions.explain: become 是瞬间音——「当医生」的状态用 be a doctor。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（——人呢？——妈妈去菜市场了）
options: Mum has gone to the market.
Mum has been to the market.
Mum have gone to the market.
questions.explain: 人不在场用 gone；Mum 三单配 has。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（自从我们见面，我们就是朋友）
options: We have been friends since we met.
We have been friends since we have met.
We are friends since we met.
questions.explain: since 小句用过去时定起点，主句挂延音线。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（上周和昨天我都练了琴）
options: I practised the piano last week and yesterday.
I have practised the piano last week and yesterday.
I have practise the piano last week and yesterday.
questions.explain: 两个日期都钉在过去——纯断音，别带 have。

stages.name: 用一用 · 两种调混排

questions.q: I ___ my key this morning, and I ___ it yet.
questions.explain: this morning 已过去用断音 lost；「到现在还没找到」挂延音线 haven't found。

questions.q: — ___ you ever ___ to the Palace Museum? — Yes, I ___ there last year.
questions.explain: 问经历 Have you been；答句带 last year——断音 went。

questions.q: My uncle ___ in Shenzhen since he ___ college.
questions.explain: since 小句用过去时定起点，主句延音。

questions.q: She ___ the piano for six years — she ___ when she was seven.
questions.explain: 延续六年挂延音线；「七岁开始」钉在过去用断音。

questions.q: — Where ___ Amy? — She ___ to the printing room. She'll be back soon.
questions.explain: 人不在场——has gone；问句是现在 is。

questions.q: I ___ this book twice, but I ___ it again last night because I love it.
questions.explain: 经历挂延音线 have read；last night 断音 read（读 /red/）。

questions.q: We ___ friends since Grade One, and we ___ in the same band now.
questions.explain: 从一年级延续到现在 have been；「现在同团」是现在时 are。

questions.q: — How long ___ you ___ your dog? — ___ three years.
questions.explain: 「养多久」用 have had；「三年」是长度答 For。

questions.q: Hurry up! The film ___ on for half an hour.
questions.explain: begin 量不了长度——「开演半小时」用 has been on。

questions.q: My parents ___ married for twenty years — they ___ married in 2006.
questions.explain: 状态延续用 have been married；in 2006 断音 got married。

questions.q: He ___ his homework, so he ___ free now.
questions.explain: 写完的影响延续到现在——has finished + is free。

questions.q: — Is your grandma at home? — No, she ___ out. She ___ out an hour ago.
questions.explain: 人不在 has gone out；an hour ago 补时间用断音 went。

questions.q: I ___ up at six, and I ___ busy since then.
questions.explain: 起床钉在六点断音 got；「从那以后一直忙」延音 have been。

questions.q: — ___ you ___ the new song yet? — Yes, I ___ it three days ago.
questions.explain: yet 问延音；答句 three days ago 断音。

questions.q: She ___ in this school since 2023, but before that she ___ in a village school.
questions.explain: since 2023 延音 has taught；before that 的事钉在过去。

questions.q: 大考：We ___ each other for ten years — we ___ in Grade One, and our friendship ___ still strong.
options: have known / met / has been still
questions.explain: 延音 have known + 断音 met（起点）+ 现在 is——三种调各就各位。

detective.sentence: I have visited the science museum last Sunday.
detective.fixed: I visited the science museum last Sunday.
detective.clue: last Sunday 有日期——延音线必须剪断，改用一般过去时。

detective.sentence: — Where is Dad? — He has been to the supermarket.
detective.fixed: — Where is Dad? — He has gone to the supermarket.
detective.clue: 人不在场要用 gone——been 是「去过且回来了」，和「人呢」对不上。

detective.sentence: We have moved to this city for five years.
detective.fixed: We have lived in this city for five years.
detective.clue: move 是一瞬间的动作，量长度要换成可延续的 live。

detective.sentence: She has knew the good news for two days.
detective.fixed: She has known the good news for two days.
detective.clue: 两件套的第二件是过去分词——know→known，knew 是过去式。

detective.sentence: My brother has joined the army since 2024.
detective.fixed: My brother has been in the army since 2024.
detective.clue: join 是瞬间动词——延续的状态用 be in the army。

detective.sentence: Have you finish your model plane yet?
detective.fixed: Have you finished your model plane yet?
detective.clue: have 后面的过去分词 -ed 不能丢——两件套缺一不可。

detective.sentence: I have got up at six this morning.
detective.fixed: I got up at six this morning.
detective.clue: this morning 已经过去，起床也钉死在六点——用断音，别带 have。
